gambia/wildlife.caption: Six Hundred Bird Species
gambia/wildlife.description: In a country you can drive across in twenty minutes. It is one of the great birding places.

guinea/lakes-rivers.caption: The Upper Niger

guinea/nature.caption: Where the Rivers Rise
guinea/nature.description: The Niger, the Senegal and the Gambia all begin within a hundred kilometres of each other.

guinea/outdoor.alt: A guinea fowl with spotted feathers walks on the ground

guinea/outdoor.caption: Trekking the Highlands

guinea/safari.alt: Mount bromo at sunrise east java, Guinea
guinea/safari.altIntended: dense forest canopy on the slopes of Mount Nimba, Guinea
guinea/safari.caption: The Forest, Not the Plain

guinea/traditional-people.alt: Portrait of an indigenous woman holding a bowl and a pole, Guinea
guinea/traditional-people.altIntended: a Fulani herder with cattle on the Fouta Djallon plateau, Guinea
guinea/traditional-people.caption: Fulani, Malinke, Susu

guinea/waterfalls.caption: Ditinn and Kinkon

guinea/why-visit.alt: Close up of a guinea pig in a cage with food bowl
guinea/why-visit.altIntended: a walker looking out over layered Fouta Djallon ridges, Guinea
guinea/why-visit.caption: Why Guinea
guinea/why-visit.description: The best walking in West Africa, and the rivers that made the whole region.

guinea/wildlife.altIntended: A chimpanzee peers through vibrant green foliage in a dense jungle setting. Perfect for wildlife themes., Guinea
guinea/wildlife.caption: Chimpanzees at Bossou
guinea/wildlife.description: One of the best-studied wild chimpanzee groups anywhere, and one that uses stone tools.

kenya/adventure.alt: Majestic lion in kenyan maasai mara landscape
kenya/adventure.altIntended: a hot-air balloon over the Maasai Mara plains at sunrise, Kenya
kenya/adventure.caption: Balloon Over the Mara
kenya/adventure.description: Up before dawn, an hour over the plains at treetop height, and breakfast on the grass where you land.

kenya/architecture.altIntended: an ornately carved Swahili door in a coral stone wall in Lamu, Kenya
kenya/architecture.caption: Coral Stone and Carved Doors

kenya/beaches.caption: The Swahili Coast

kenya/cities.alt: Black rhino on dry land in kenya

kenya/cities.caption: Nairobi, Green City in the Sun
kenya/cities.description: The only capital on earth with a national park inside the city limits, and lions in sight of the skyline.

kenya/crafts.altIntended: Maasai women stringing beadwork ornaments, Kenya
kenya/crafts.caption: Beadwork and Kisii Stone
kenya/crafts.description: Maasai beadwork, Kisii soapstone carving, and kiondo sisal baskets made the way they always were.

kenya/culture.altIntended: Maasai elders in red shuka cloth on the open plains, Kenya
kenya/culture.caption: Maasai and Swahili
kenya/culture.description: Two Kenyas: the cattle-keeping highlands and the coral-stone, Arabic-inflected coast.

kenya/eco-tourism.alt: Large black rhino on savannah, Kenya

kenya/eco-tourism.caption: Rhino, Counted Daily

kenya/family-community.alt: Wildebeest migration in maasai mara, Kenya
kenya/family-community.altIntended: a community conservancy ranger team on patrol near the Maasai Mara, Kenya
kenya/family-community.caption: The Conservancies

kenya/festivals.alt: Two men on a fishing boat, Kenya
kenya/festivals.altIntended: Two local fishermen navigate a traditional dhow on the clear waters of Zanzibar under a bright blue sky., Kenya
kenya/festivals.caption: Lamu Cultural Festival
kenya/festivals.description: Dhow races, donkey races, henna and taarab music in the alleys of a town with almost no cars.

kenya/food.altIntended: nyama choma roasting over charcoal at a Nairobi grill, Kenya
kenya/food.caption: Nyama Choma and Ugali
kenya/food.description: Goat roasted over charcoal, maize meal, sukuma wiki, and coastal biryani that came in by dhow.

kenya/forests.alt: Dense lush forest in madikeri karnataka, Kenya
kenya/forests.altIntended: dense canopy and hanging vines inside Kakamega Forest, Kenya
kenya/forests.caption: Kakamega, the Last of It
kenya/forests.description: The only Kenyan remnant of the Guineo-Congolian rainforest that once ran clear across the continent.

kenya/heritage.alt: Boats sailing on the sea under blue sky, Kenya
kenya/heritage.altIntended: carved wooden doors and coral stone alleys in Lamu Old Town, Kenya
kenya/heritage.caption: Lamu Old Town
kenya/heritage.description: The oldest continuously inhabited Swahili settlement, carved doors, coral rag walls and no room for a car.

kenya/hero.alt: Playful lion cub in kenyan grasslands
kenya/hero.altIntended: acacia and open grassland in the Maasai Mara at sunrise, Kenya
kenya/hero.caption: Where the Safari Was Invented
kenya/hero.description: The Maasai Mara at first light, and everything the word safari has meant for a century.

kenya/hidden-gems.alt: Safari adventure in nakuru kenya s scenic landscape
kenya/hidden-gems.altIntended: the salt pan and dunes of the Chalbi desert in northern Kenya
kenya/hidden-gems.caption: Chalbi and Marsabit

kenya/historic-sites.alt: The ruins of a temple in the middle of a field, Kenya
kenya/historic-sites.altIntended: the coral ramparts of Fort Jesus above Mombasa old harbour, Kenya
kenya/historic-sites.caption: Fort Jesus, Mombasa

kenya/lakes-rivers.alt: Herd of zebras grazing near a lake, Kenya
kenya/lakes-rivers.altIntended: flamingos massed on the shallows of Lake Nakuru, Kenya
kenya/lakes-rivers.caption: Flamingo Country
kenya/lakes-rivers.description: Nakuru, Bogoria and Elementaita hold soda water, hot springs and flamingo in numbers that change by the season.

kenya/local-life.altIntended: brightly painted matatu minibuses in a Nairobi street, Kenya
kenya/local-life.caption: Matatus and Markets
kenya/local-life.description: Painted, over-amplified matatus, Maasai Market on rotation through the week, and tea at every stop.

kenya/luxury.alt: Cheetah looking at the landscape, Kenya
kenya/luxury.altIntended: a luxury tented safari camp overlooking the Maasai Mara plains, Kenya
kenya/luxury.caption: Camps on the Mara

kenya/mountains.alt: Giraffe under acacia tree in nakuru kenya
kenya/mountains.altIntended: the jagged glaciated peaks of Mount Kenya above the moorland
kenya/mountains.caption: Mount Kenya, 5,199 m

kenya/nature.altIntended: the Great Rift Valley escarpment and floor seen from the Naivasha road, Kenya
kenya/nature.caption: The Great Rift Valley

kenya/outdoor.alt: The uhuru park in nairobi kenya
kenya/outdoor.altIntended: cyclists on the track between the cliffs of Hell's Gate National Park, Kenya
kenya/outdoor.caption: Walking Hell's Gate
kenya/outdoor.description: The one Kenyan park you can walk and cycle through, with gorge scrambling and geothermal steam.

kenya/photography.alt: Starry night over mount kilimanjaro from kenya

kenya/photography.caption: Kilimanjaro from Amboseli

kenya/safari.alt: Wildebeest grazing in the kenyan savannah
kenya/safari.altIntended: wildebeest crossing the Mara river during the great migration, Kenya
kenya/safari.caption: The Great Migration

kenya/traditional-people.alt: Traditional maasai warrior in mombasa kenya
kenya/traditional-people.altIntended: a Samburu warrior with beaded ornaments in the northern drylands, Kenya
kenya/traditional-people.caption: Samburu and Maasai

kenya/waterfalls.alt: Adventurous hiker at majestic waterfall scene, Kenya

kenya/why-visit.altIntended: acacia silhouetted against a red sunset on the Kenyan savannah
kenya/why-visit.caption: Magical Kenya

kenya/wildlife.alt: Cheetah stalking through kenyan savannah grass
kenya/wildlife.altIntended: elephants crossing the plain at Amboseli beneath Kilimanjaro, Kenya
kenya/wildlife.caption: Wildlife on the Savannah
kenya/wildlife.description: The Big Five, plus the reticulated giraffe and Grevy's zebra that live nowhere south of here.

lesotho/adventure.alt: Riders traversing snowy mountain landscape in winter, Lesotho

lesotho/architecture.alt: Man in traditional coat sitting by pile of corn, Lesotho

lesotho/beaches.altIntended: the Katse dam wall and reservoir between mountains, Lesotho

lesotho/cities.altIntended: the main street and sandstone buildings of Maseru, Lesotho

lesotho/crafts.alt: Unfinished handmade tapestry with shuttle on hand loom, Lesotho
lesotho/crafts.altIntended: a woven mohair tapestry on a loom in Lesotho
lesotho/crafts.caption: Blankets, Hats and Tapestry

lesotho/culture.alt: Man in traditional yellow garb and sunglasses, Lesotho

lesotho/eco-tourism.alt: Concrete wall of a water reservoir, Lesotho

lesotho/family-community.alt: Children standing beside horses on white sand, Lesotho
lesotho/family-community.altIntended: children on Basotho ponies with a guide, Lesotho
lesotho/family-community.caption: Ponies and Snow
lesotho/family-community.description: Short pony treks, dinosaur footprints and, in winter, actual snow.

lesotho/festivals.alt: White plastic chair in front of old hut, Lesotho
lesotho/festivals.altIntended: horse racing at the Morija cultural festival, Lesotho
lesotho/festivals.caption: Morija Arts and Cultural Festival

lesotho/food.altIntended: a bowl of papa with moroho greens, Lesotho
lesotho/food.caption: Papa, Moroho and Motoho
lesotho/food.description: Maize papa with wild greens, and motoho — fermented sorghum drink.

lesotho/forests.alt: A city with many buildings YtkaWPrJQM, Lesotho
lesotho/forests.altIntended: a patch of indigenous forest in a sheltered Lesotho gorge
lesotho/forests.caption: Almost None
lesotho/forests.description: Above the treeline for most of the country, and the small patches left are protected.

lesotho/heritage.alt: Snow capped mountains in teyateyaneng lesotho
lesotho/heritage.altIntended: San rock paintings on a sandstone overhang in Lesotho
lesotho/heritage.caption: Maloti-Drakensberg
lesotho/heritage.description: A World Heritage site shared with South Africa, for its landscape and its San rock art.

lesotho/hero.alt: A field with a fence and mountains in the background, Lesotho

lesotho/hero.caption: The Kingdom in the Sky
lesotho/hero.description: Nowhere in Lesotho is below 1,400 metres, which is true of no other country.

lesotho/hidden-gems.altIntended: fossil dinosaur footprints in exposed sandstone rock, Lesotho
lesotho/hidden-gems.caption: Dinosaur Footprints
lesotho/hidden-gems.description: Trackways in the sandstone at Moyeni and Morija, in the open and unfenced.

lesotho/historic-sites.alt: Exterior view of historic stone building, Lesotho

lesotho/historic-sites.caption: Thaba Bosiu

lesotho/lakes-rivers.alt: Scenic river in the drakensberg mountains, Lesotho

lesotho/lakes-rivers.caption: The Senqu
lesotho/lakes-rivers.description: The Orange river rises here and runs the whole width of South Africa afterwards.

lesotho/local-life.alt: Winter herding scene in snowy mountain landscape, Lesotho
lesotho/local-life.altIntended: villagers on horseback on a mountain track, Lesotho
lesotho/local-life.caption: Sunday on Horseback
lesotho/local-life.description: The horse is transport, not recreation, and every village has them saddled.

lesotho/luxury.altIntended: a mountain lodge with stone buildings at Semonkong, Lesotho
lesotho/luxury.caption: Lodges and Trading Posts

lesotho/mountains.alt: Snow capped mountains in teyateyaneng lesotho

lesotho/mountains.caption: Thabana Ntlenyana

lesotho/nature.alt: Scenic landscape of lesotho s mountainous terrain
lesotho/nature.altIntended: Serene view of Lesotho's lush fields and rugged mountains under clear blue skies.
lesotho/nature.caption: The Maloti
lesotho/nature.description: Basalt highlands cut by river gorges, and the roof of southern Africa.

lesotho/photography.alt: Golden autumn forest under cloudy blue sky, Lesotho
lesotho/photography.altIntended: clear autumn light on golden grassland and basalt ridges, Lesotho
lesotho/photography.caption: High and Clear
lesotho/photography.description: The Maloti in autumn, when the grass turns and the air will not hold any haze.

lesotho/safari.alt: Eland and zebras grazing in african savanna, Lesotho
lesotho/safari.altIntended: A peaceful scene of eland and zebras grazing in the African savanna., Lesotho
lesotho/safari.caption: Not the Business Here

lesotho/traditional-people.alt: Shepherd guiding flock in rural pasture, Lesotho
lesotho/traditional-people.altIntended: Basotho herders in blankets with sheep on a high pasture, Lesotho
lesotho/traditional-people.caption: The Basotho
lesotho/traditional-people.description: One people, one language, and a kingdom that kept its independence by going uphill.

lesotho/waterfalls.altIntended: the single 192-metre drop of the Maletsunyane falls, Lesotho
lesotho/waterfalls.caption: Maletsunyane
lesotho/waterfalls.description: 192 metres in a single drop, and a commercial abseil down beside it.

lesotho/why-visit.alt: Shetland pony on snow covered ground, Lesotho
lesotho/why-visit.altIntended: a rider on a Basotho pony against a wide mountain horizon, Lesotho
lesotho/why-visit.caption: Why Lesotho
lesotho/why-visit.description: A whole country above a thousand metres, crossed on a pony, with snow in July.

lesotho/wildlife.alt: Majestic vulture soaring in clear sky, Lesotho
lesotho/wildlife.altIntended: a bearded vulture in flight along a mountain escarpment, Lesotho
lesotho/wildlife.caption: Bearded Vulture and Eland
lesotho/wildlife.description: The lammergeier breeds on the Drakensberg escarpment, and eland are back in the reserves.

liberia/adventure.altIntended: a surfer on a long left-hand wave at Robertsport, Liberia
liberia/adventure.caption: Surfing Robertsport
liberia/adventure.description: Cassava Point and Fisherman's Point — long left-hand point breaks, and a village surf club.

liberia/architecture.altIntended: An African woman selling goods on the streets of Monrovia, Liberia.
liberia/architecture.caption: Verandah and Zinc
liberia/architecture.description: Americo-Liberian timber houses with deep verandahs, and zinc-roofed cityscape behind them.

liberia/beaches.alt: Fishermen pulling canoe on liberian beach
liberia/beaches.altIntended: an empty palm-backed beach on the Liberian Atlantic coast
liberia/beaches.caption: Five Hundred Kilometres of Atlantic
liberia/beaches.description: Long empty beaches, and a serious swell from November on.

liberia/cities.alt: Young girl preparing fruits at monrovia market, Liberia
liberia/cities.altIntended: the waterfront and low skyline of Monrovia, Liberia
liberia/cities.caption: Monrovia
liberia/cities.description: A capital on a peninsula between the Atlantic and the Mesurado, rebuilt and rebuilding.

liberia/crafts.altIntended: a carved wooden Dan mask with a smooth blackened surface, Liberia
liberia/crafts.caption: Masks and Country Cloth
liberia/crafts.description: Poro and Sande society masks in the interior, and woven country cloth everywhere.

liberia/culture.altIntended: a nineteenth-century settler house with a verandah in Monrovia, Liberia
liberia/culture.caption: Americo-Liberian and Sixteen Others
liberia/culture.description: A settler republic founded in 1822 over sixteen indigenous peoples, and the tension of that.

liberia/eco-tourism.alt: Children playing on a beach in liberia
liberia/eco-tourism.altIntended: an aerial view of unbroken rainforest canopy in Liberia
liberia/eco-tourism.caption: Forty Per Cent of What Is Left
liberia/eco-tourism.description: Liberia's forest is the largest surviving piece of the Upper Guinean block.

liberia/family-community.altIntended: children swimming in the pool below Kpatawee falls, Liberia
liberia/family-community.caption: Kpatawee and the Coast
liberia/family-community.description: A waterfall pool inland and calm bays on the coast, both easy days out.

liberia/festivals.alt: Two boys on their bike cycle, Liberia
liberia/festivals.altIntended: an Independence Day parade in the streets of Monrovia, Liberia
liberia/festivals.caption: Independence Day
liberia/festivals.description: 26 July, and the parades, the food and the noise that come with it.

liberia/food.alt: Swirling of creamy peanut butter, Liberia
liberia/food.altIntended: a bowl of palm butter soup with rice and fish, Liberia
liberia/food.caption: Jollof, Palm Butter and Fufu
liberia/food.description: Palm butter soup, cassava fufu, and a jollof Liberians will argue about at length.

liberia/forests.alt: Mountain covered with trees under blue sky, Liberia
liberia/forests.altIntended: A breathtaking view of a lush tropical rainforest shrouded in mist and clouds., Liberia
liberia/forests.caption: Sapo and Gola
liberia/forests.description: Two blocks of high forest, both transboundary, and the best-protected in the region.

liberia/heritage.alt: Traditional fishing boat on monrovia coastline, Liberia
liberia/heritage.altIntended: a decaying nineteenth-century settler mansion in Monrovia, Liberia
liberia/heritage.caption: A Republic Built by the Freed
liberia/heritage.description: Monrovia's nineteenth-century houses are the architecture of a return that did not go simply.

liberia/hero.alt: Wooden pathway and tall trees, Liberia
liberia/hero.altIntended: closed rainforest canopy and a river in Sapo National Park, Liberia
liberia/hero.caption: Sapo
liberia/hero.description: Rainforest with pygmy hippo, forest elephant and chimpanzee, and no road into most of it.

liberia/hidden-gems.alt: Green trees beside sea under white sky, Liberia
liberia/hidden-gems.altIntended: fishing canoes on the still water of Lake Piso, Liberia
liberia/hidden-gems.caption: Lake Piso
liberia/hidden-gems.description: A lagoon behind Robertsport with mangrove, fishing villages and no visitors.

liberia/historic-sites.alt: Travelers exploring forest with huge tall tree, Liberia
liberia/historic-sites.altIntended: the old cotton tree and monument on Providence Island, Liberia
liberia/historic-sites.caption: Providence Island
liberia/historic-sites.description: Where the first settlers landed in 1822, in the middle of Monrovia's harbour.

liberia/lakes-rivers.alt: Trees near a foggy lake, Liberia
liberia/lakes-rivers.caption: The Saint Paul and the Cavalla
liberia/lakes-rivers.description: The Saint Paul runs past Monrovia; the Cavalla marks the whole Ivorian border.

liberia/local-life.altIntended: beach bars and crowds along the shore at Sinkor, Monrovia, Liberia
liberia/local-life.caption: The Beach at Sinkor
liberia/local-life.description: Monrovia goes to the beach bars along Sinkor at the weekend, and stays.

liberia/luxury.alt: Young men socializing by a fishing boat in liberia
liberia/luxury.altIntended: a simple beach lodge under palms at Robertsport, Liberia
liberia/luxury.caption: Beginning
liberia/luxury.description: Beach lodges at Robertsport and a few good hotels in Monrovia.

liberia/mountains.alt: Misty mountain range at dawn, Liberia
liberia/mountains.altIntended: A misty mountain range enveloped in early morning light., Liberia
liberia/mountains.caption: Mount Nimba and Wologizi
liberia/mountains.description: Nimba on the Guinean border, and the Wologizi range with the highest ground in the country.

liberia/nature.alt: Tree ferns with large foliage growing in rainforest, Liberia
liberia/nature.altIntended: buttressed rainforest trees and lianas in Liberian forest
liberia/nature.caption: The Upper Guinean Forest
liberia/nature.description: Liberia holds about forty per cent of what is left of it.

liberia/outdoor.alt: Piel de sapo melon on earthy ground, Liberia
liberia/outdoor.altIntended: a ranger camp under tarpaulins in Sapo rainforest, Liberia
liberia/outdoor.caption: Sapo on Foot
liberia/outdoor.description: Multi-day forest walking with rangers, sleeping in camps, and no vehicles at all.

liberia/photography.alt: Lush green rainforest foliage close up view, Liberia
liberia/photography.altIntended: A vibrant close-up of lush green rainforest leaves with a rich natural texture ideal for nature and environmental themes., Liberia
liberia/photography.caption: Green and Water
liberia/photography.description: Sapo after rain, when the canopy drips and the light comes through in shafts.

liberia/safari.alt: Black and white photo of a train in a theme park, Liberia
liberia/safari.altIntended: a tracker on a forest path in Sapo National Park, Liberia
liberia/safari.caption: Forest Tracking
liberia/safari.description: There is no game drive here. Sapo is walked, with trackers, over days.

liberia/traditional-people.alt: Colorful traditional dress in monrovia harbor, Liberia
liberia/traditional-people.altIntended: carved Vai script characters on a wooden board, Liberia
liberia/traditional-people.caption: Kpelle, Bassa, Grebo, Vai
liberia/traditional-people.description: The Vai invented their own script in the 1830s, one of very few in Africa.

liberia/waterfalls.alt: Majestic waterfall in doi inthanon national park chiang mai, Liberia
liberia/waterfalls.altIntended: the Kpatawee waterfall falling over granite into a pool, Liberia
liberia/waterfalls.caption: Kpatawee
liberia/waterfalls.description: Falls over granite ledges into a swimmable pool in Bong county.

liberia/wildlife.altIntended: a pygmy hippo at the edge of a forest stream at night, Liberia
liberia/wildlife.caption: The Pygmy Hippo
liberia/wildlife.description: Nocturnal, solitary, forest-dwelling, and one of the rarest large mammals in Africa.

libya/adventure.alt: Brown rock formation under blue sky, Libya
libya/adventure.altIntended: a desert camp under a rock arch in the Acacus at night, Libya
libya/adventure.caption: Into the Acacus
libya/adventure.description: Four-wheel-drive expeditions of a week, camping under the arches with Tuareg guides.

libya/architecture.altIntended: the whitewashed roof terraces and covered alleys of Ghadames, Libya
libya/architecture.caption: Ghadames
libya/architecture.description: A covered mud-brick town where the streets are tunnels and the roofs are the women's road.

libya/beaches.altIntended: an empty white sand beach on the Libyan Mediterranean coast
libya/beaches.caption: Two Thousand Kilometres of Coast
libya/beaches.description: The longest Mediterranean coastline of any African country, and almost none of it built on.

libya/crafts.alt: Fashionable man in black leather jacket and cross pendant, Libya
libya/crafts.altIntended: Close-up of a man wearing a stylish black leather jacket and cross pendant, showcasing edgy fashion., Libya
libya/crafts.caption: Silver and Leather
libya/crafts.description: Tuareg silver crosses, tooled leather from Ghadames, and Berber weaving in the Nafusa.

libya/culture.alt: Luxury mercedes benz cls on city street at twilight, Libya
libya/culture.altIntended: a busy market street in the medina of Tripoli, Libya
libya/culture.caption: Arab, Berber, Tuareg, Tebu
libya/culture.description: Four peoples and three languages, and a coast that has been Phoenician, Greek, Roman, Ottoman and Italian.

libya/eco-tourism.alt: Ancient roman theater in aspendos antalya, Libya
libya/eco-tourism.altIntended: sand drifted against the standing columns of a Roman street, Libya
libya/eco-tourism.caption: What the Desert Keeps
libya/eco-tourism.description: Sand buried Leptis Magna for a thousand years, which is why there is so much of it left.

libya/family-community.alt: Ancient roman temple ruins under blue sky, Libya
libya/family-community.altIntended: children running along a Roman street at Leptis Magna, Libya
libya/family-community.caption: Roman Cities Are Good for This
libya/family-community.description: Leptis is enormous, empty and safe to run around in, which not every ruin is.

libya/festivals.alt: Traditional tuareg festival with decorated horse, Libya
libya/festivals.altIntended: Tuareg riders racing camels at the Ghat festival, Libya
libya/festivals.caption: Ghat and the Desert Festivals
libya/festivals.description: The Ghat festival brings Tuareg from three countries for racing, music and poetry.

libya/food.alt: Seafood and rice on table, Libya
libya/food.altIntended: a shared plate of Libyan bazin with lamb and sauce
libya/food.caption: Bazin and Bsisa
libya/food.description: Bazin with lamb and paprika, couscous on Fridays, and shorba on the table all Ramadan.

libya/forests.altIntended: juniper forest on the slopes of the Jebel Akhdar, Libya
libya/forests.caption: The Green Mountain
libya/forests.description: Juniper and cypress on the Jebel Akhdar, the only real forest in the country.

libya/heritage.altIntended: prehistoric rock engravings of giraffe in the Acacus, Libya
libya/heritage.caption: Five Sites, All of Them Major
libya/heritage.description: Leptis, Sabratha, Cyrene, Ghadames and the Acacus rock art — every one on the World Heritage list.

libya/hero.alt: Arch of trajan timgad ancient thamugadi near batna algeria, Libya
libya/hero.altIntended: the colonnaded forum and basilica of Leptis Magna, Libya
libya/hero.caption: Leptis Magna
libya/hero.description: A Roman city of a hundred thousand people, buried by sand and dug out almost complete.

libya/hidden-gems.alt: Majestic cliffs of moher overlooking atlantic, Libya
libya/hidden-gems.altIntended: the black volcanic crater and green lakes of Waw an Namus, Libya
libya/hidden-gems.caption: Waw an Namus
libya/hidden-gems.description: A black volcanic caldera in the middle of the Sahara with green lakes at the bottom.

libya/historic-sites.alt: Ancient roman theatre in bosra syria, Libya
libya/historic-sites.altIntended: Explore the ancient Roman theatre in Bosra, a UNESCO World Heritage Site showcasing classical architecture in Syria., Libya
libya/historic-sites.caption: Cyrene and Sabratha
libya/historic-sites.description: A Greek city on an escarpment above the sea, and a Roman theatre facing the water at Sabratha.

libya/lakes-rivers.altIntended: Gaberoun lake between high dunes in the Ubari sand sea, Libya
libya/lakes-rivers.caption: The Ubari Lakes
libya/lakes-rivers.description: Salt lakes between dunes, the last of them dense enough to float in.

libya/local-life.alt: Close up of pouring water to tea, Libya
libya/local-life.altIntended: hands pouring Libyan tea from a height into small glasses
libya/local-life.caption: Tea, Three Times
libya/local-life.description: Poured from a height, three glasses, and no conversation is finished before the third.

libya/luxury.alt: A group of boys crouching in front of damaged buildings, Libya
libya/luxury.altIntended: a restored merchant's courtyard house in Tripoli medina, Libya
libya/luxury.caption: Thin on the Ground
libya/luxury.description: There is very little at the top end here, and what exists is in Tripoli.

libya/mountains.altIntended: a natural rock arch in the Acacus mountains at sunset, Libya
libya/mountains.caption: The Acacus
libya/mountains.description: Volcanic rock arches and towers on the Algerian border, with rock art under them.

libya/nature.altIntended: dunes of the Ubari sand sea with a palm-fringed lake below, Libya
libya/nature.caption: The Sand Sea and the Jebel
libya/nature.description: The Ubari sand sea in the southwest, and the green Jebel Akhdar behind Benghazi.

libya/outdoor.alt: A mountain with a rocky cliff and a cloudy sky, Libya
libya/outdoor.altIntended: Rugged rock formations under dramatic dark clouds during sunset, perfect for nature lovers., Libya
libya/outdoor.caption: The Jebel Akhdar
libya/outdoor.description: Walking on the green mountain between Greek tombs cut into the rock.

libya/photography.alt: Ancient ruins in palmyra under blue sky, Libya
libya/photography.altIntended: the arches of Sabratha's theatre with the sea beyond at sunset, Libya
libya/photography.caption: Stone and Sea
libya/photography.description: Sabratha's theatre with the Mediterranean through its arches, in the last hour of light.

libya/safari.alt: An off road car on the desert, Libya
libya/safari.altIntended: a desert track crossing gravel plain in the Libyan Sahara
libya/safari.caption: Tracking, Not Driving
libya/safari.description: The wildlife is thin and shy. What you go out to see is the country it survives in.

libya/traditional-people.alt: Traditional sugar cane processing in rural setting, Libya
libya/traditional-people.altIntended: a Tebu man beside a camel in southern Libya
libya/traditional-people.caption: The Tuareg and the Tebu
libya/traditional-people.description: The Tuareg in the southwest around Ghat, the Tebu in the Tibesti foothills in the southeast.

libya/waterfalls.alt: Man in black jacket and white pants sitting on brown lounge chait near swimming pool, Libya
libya/waterfalls.altIntended: a spring-fed pool among palms in a Libyan desert oasis
libya/waterfalls.caption: Wadi Country
libya/waterfalls.description: No permanent rivers. The water is in wadis that run once a decade and in springs at the oases.

libya/why-visit.alt: Vintage cadillac front view in benghazi, Libya
libya/why-visit.altIntended: A classic 1970s red Cadillac with chrome details in Benghazi, Libya.
libya/why-visit.caption: Why Libya
libya/why-visit.description: Because Leptis Magna is the best Roman city left anywhere, and hardly anyone has stood in it.

libya/wildlife.alt: Barbary sheep grazing on grassland, Libya
libya/wildlife.altIntended: a Barbary sheep on rock in the Acacus mountains, Libya
libya/wildlife.caption: Desert Survivors
libya/wildlife.description: Barbary sheep in the Acacus, dorcas gazelle on the gravel plains, and very little else.

madagascar/adventure.alt: Person walking along lush green forest edge, Madagascar
madagascar/adventure.altIntended: a walker crossing the tsingy on a rope bridge, Madagascar
madagascar/adventure.caption: The RN7 and the Tsingy
madagascar/adventure.description: The road south through the highlands, and the limestone tsingy you cross on via ferrata.

madagascar/architecture.alt: A window in a brick building with a wooden frame, Madagascar
madagascar/architecture.altIntended: red brick highland houses with wooden balconies, Madagascar
madagascar/architecture.caption: Highland Brick
madagascar/architecture.description: Two-storey red brick with a wooden balcony, and nothing else in Africa looks like it.

madagascar/beaches.alt: People on a beach at sunset, Madagascar
madagascar/beaches.altIntended: a white sand beach and turquoise water at Nosy Be, Madagascar
madagascar/beaches.caption: Nosy Be and the East Coast
madagascar/beaches.description: Reef, whale sharks and humpbacks off Nosy Be, and long empty sand on the east coast.

madagascar/cities.alt: Scenic hillside view with densely packed housing, Madagascar
madagascar/cities.altIntended: the stepped hillside houses of Antananarivo, Madagascar
madagascar/cities.caption: Antananarivo
madagascar/cities.description: A capital built up twelve hills, with stairs instead of streets in half of it.

madagascar/crafts.altIntended: a woman weaving a silk lamba on a wooden loom, Madagascar
madagascar/crafts.caption: Silk, Raffia and Zafimaniry
madagascar/crafts.description: Wild silk lambas, raffia work, and the Zafimaniry woodcarving of the south-east.

madagascar/culture.alt: Aerial footage of village in a mountain, Madagascar
madagascar/culture.altIntended: a highland Malagasy village of red brick houses, Madagascar
madagascar/culture.caption: Malagasy, and Eighteen Peoples
madagascar/culture.description: One language across the island, of Austronesian origin, and eighteen distinct peoples speaking it.

madagascar/eco-tourism.altIntended: a reforestation nursery beside a Madagascar rainforest park
madagascar/eco-tourism.caption: The Reason to Come Carefully
madagascar/eco-tourism.description: Deforestation is the country's crisis, and the parks that work are the ones the villages run.

madagascar/family-community.alt: Children playing in rural african village, Madagascar
madagascar/family-community.altIntended: children on a village path in rural Madagascar
madagascar/family-community.caption: Slow, and Worth It
madagascar/family-community.description: Roads are slow and distances are long — but the children will hold a chameleon.

madagascar/festivals.alt: Vibrant african cultural dance performance outdoors, Madagascar
madagascar/festivals.altIntended: A group of people in traditional African attire performing a cultural dance outdoors., Madagascar
madagascar/festivals.caption: Hira Gasy and Donia
madagascar/festivals.description: Hira gasy troupes in the highlands, and the Donia festival on Nosy Be in June.

madagascar/food.altIntended: romazava and rice served at a Malagasy table, Madagascar
madagascar/food.caption: Romazava and Rice
madagascar/food.description: Rice three times a day, and romazava — beef and greens — with it.

madagascar/forests.alt: A jellyfish and an octopus underwater, Madagascar
madagascar/forests.altIntended: the spiny forest of octopus trees in southern Madagascar
madagascar/forests.caption: Rainforest and Spiny Forest
madagascar/forests.description: Andasibe and Ranomafana in the east, and the spiny forest of the south which is like nowhere.

madagascar/heritage.alt: Brown cross stand on grass, Madagascar
madagascar/heritage.altIntended: A moss-covered cross stands in an overgrown, ancient cemetery, evoking a mysterious atmosphere., Madagascar
madagascar/heritage.caption: Pirates and Kingdoms
madagascar/heritage.description: Île Sainte-Marie's pirate cemetery, and the Merina kingdom that unified the island.

madagascar/hero.alt: Silhouette of a girl walking on water with fish net, Madagascar
madagascar/hero.altIntended: the avenue of baobabs at Morondava at sunset, Madagascar
madagascar/hero.caption: An Island That Evolved Alone
madagascar/hero.description: Ninety per cent of what lives here lives nowhere else, because it has been on its own since the dinosaurs.

madagascar/hidden-gems.alt: Green reptile on green leaf, Madagascar
madagascar/hidden-gems.altIntended: the rainforest of Masoala coming down to the sea, Madagascar
madagascar/hidden-gems.caption: Masoala
madagascar/hidden-gems.description: The largest protected rainforest in the country, reached by boat, with whales in the bay.

madagascar/historic-sites.alt: Town surrounded by mountains and hills at dusk, Madagascar
madagascar/historic-sites.altIntended: Beautiful rural landscape of Taunggyi, Myanmar with misty hills during dusk., Madagascar
madagascar/historic-sites.caption: The Rova and the Royal Hills
madagascar/historic-sites.description: Ambohimanga, the royal hill of the Merina kings above Antananarivo.

madagascar/lakes-rivers.alt: Lush green canyon with winding river, Madagascar
madagascar/lakes-rivers.altIntended: a pirogue on the Tsiribihina river at dawn, Madagascar
madagascar/lakes-rivers.caption: The Tsiribihina
madagascar/lakes-rivers.description: Three days downriver by pirogue through country with no road in it.

madagascar/local-life.alt: Grayscale photo of cattle on grass field, Madagascar
madagascar/local-life.altIntended: a zebu cattle market in the Madagascar highlands
madagascar/local-life.caption: The Zebu Market
madagascar/local-life.description: Zebu cattle are wealth here, and the markets that trade them are the real calendar.

madagascar/luxury.alt: An aerial photography of a wooden house near the green trees, Madagascar
madagascar/luxury.altIntended: a small lodge among trees at a Madagascar park gate
madagascar/luxury.caption: Small Lodges
madagascar/luxury.description: Owner-run lodges at the park gates, and beach places on Nosy Be with a dozen rooms.

madagascar/mountains.alt: Rice paddies on the side of a mountain, Madagascar
madagascar/mountains.altIntended: terraced rice paddies in the Madagascar highlands
madagascar/mountains.caption: The Highlands and Maromokotro
madagascar/mountains.description: The central highlands run to two thousand metres; Maromokotro reaches 2,876 in the Tsaratanana.

madagascar/nature.altIntended: the tsingy limestone pinnacles of Bemaraha, Madagascar
madagascar/nature.caption: Six Ecosystems on One Island
madagascar/nature.description: Rainforest east, highlands centre, spiny forest south, dry deciduous west, and reef all round.

madagascar/outdoor.alt: Colorful boats docked on madagascar coastline
madagascar/outdoor.altIntended: kayaks on the water off a Madagascar reef island
madagascar/outdoor.caption: Trek, Paddle, Dive
madagascar/outdoor.description: Rainforest trekking, the Tsiribihina by pirogue, and reef diving off Nosy Be.

madagascar/photography.alt: Men sitting in boat on a wide river, Madagascar
madagascar/photography.altIntended: baobabs silhouetted against the sky at Morondava, Madagascar
madagascar/photography.caption: Baobabs at Six
madagascar/photography.description: The avenue at Morondava for twenty minutes at either end of the day, and nothing else like it.

madagascar/safari.alt: Selective focus photography of green and brown chameleon perched on brown tree branch at daytime, Madagascar
madagascar/safari.altIntended: a chameleon on a branch in Ranomafana rainforest, Madagascar
madagascar/safari.caption: Not a Safari Island
madagascar/safari.description: No lions and no elephant — the wildlife here is small, nocturnal, and worth the torchlight.

madagascar/traditional-people.alt: Woman in black long sleeves and pants standing near tomb, Madagascar
madagascar/traditional-people.altIntended: Woman dressed in black standing by a tombstone in a graveyard, surrounded by trees., Madagascar
madagascar/traditional-people.caption: Famadihana and the Ancestors
madagascar/traditional-people.description: The ancestors are present here in a way that shapes the calendar and the architecture.

madagascar/waterfalls.altIntended: a waterfall in rainforest on the eastern escarpment, Madagascar
madagascar/waterfalls.caption: The Eastern Escarpment
madagascar/waterfalls.description: Short, steep rivers off the escarpment, and waterfalls through the rainforest at Andasibe.

madagascar/why-visit.alt: Ring tailed lemur in lush madagascar foliage
madagascar/why-visit.altIntended: a ring-tailed lemur troop in southern Madagascar
madagascar/why-visit.caption: Nowhere Else
madagascar/why-visit.description: Lemurs, baobabs, tsingy, spiny forest — none of it exists anywhere else on earth.

madagascar/wildlife.alt: Playful brown lemur eating in natural habitat, Madagascar
madagascar/wildlife.altIntended: an indri lemur in the rainforest canopy at Andasibe, Madagascar
madagascar/wildlife.caption: A Hundred Kinds of Lemur
madagascar/wildlife.description: A hundred and seven species and subspecies of lemur, every one of them endemic.

malawi/adventure.altIntended: kayakers paddling along the rocky shore of Lake Malawi
malawi/adventure.caption: Diving, Kayak and the Massif
malawi/adventure.description: Freshwater diving on the cichlid reefs, kayaking the lake shore, and Mulanje for a week.

malawi/architecture.alt: Sunlit corridor with brick walls in blantyre, Malawi
malawi/architecture.altIntended: the stone facade of the Blantyre mission church, Malawi
malawi/architecture.caption: Mission Stone and Lakeshore Brick
malawi/architecture.description: Scottish mission churches in stone, and fired brick along the lake.

malawi/beaches.alt: Serene lake superior shoreline in thunder bay, Malawi
malawi/beaches.altIntended: a beach and clear water at Nkhata Bay on Lake Malawi
malawi/beaches.caption: Freshwater Beaches
malawi/beaches.description: Landlocked, and it does not matter: Cape Maclear, Nkhata Bay and Likoma have sand and clear water.

malawi/crafts.alt: Colorful african fabric display at market stall, Malawi
malawi/crafts.altIntended: printed chitenje cloth stacked at a market stall, Malawi
malawi/crafts.caption: Carving and Chitenje
malawi/crafts.description: Blackwood carving, basketry, and the printed chitenje cloth worn everywhere.

malawi/culture.alt: Serene lakeside view with people and boat, Malawi
malawi/culture.altIntended: people talking at a lakeside village market in Malawi
malawi/culture.caption: The Warm Heart
malawi/culture.description: The reputation for friendliness is real, and it is the first thing every visitor mentions.

malawi/eco-tourism.alt: Zebra at a waterhole in natural habitat, Malawi
malawi/eco-tourism.altIntended: a ranger and vehicle at a waterhole in Majete, Malawi
malawi/eco-tourism.caption: Majete's Recovery
malawi/eco-tourism.description: African Parks took on an empty park in 2003 and it has the big five and no poaching now.

malawi/family-community.alt: Close up of a striped african cichlid fish, Malawi
malawi/family-community.altIntended: children swimming from a beach on Lake Malawi
malawi/family-community.caption: Easy, and Warm
malawi/family-community.description: Short distances, no malaria-free claim but a very manageable country with children.

malawi/festivals.altIntended: a crowd at a music festival on the shore of Lake Malawi
malawi/festivals.caption: The Lake of Stars
malawi/festivals.description: A music festival on the shore, and Gule Wamkulu in the villages all year.

malawi/food.alt: Grilled fresh fish on outdoor beach barbecue, Malawi
malawi/food.altIntended: a grilled chambo fish served with nsima, Malawi
malawi/food.caption: Nsima and Chambo
malawi/food.description: Nsima with relish, and chambo — a lake cichlid — grilled whole on the shore.

malawi/forests.alt: Captivating sunset over verdant hills, Malawi
malawi/forests.altIntended: A stunning sunset casts vibrant colors over rolling green hills, creating a serene landscape., Malawi
malawi/forests.caption: Nyika and Zomba
malawi/forests.description: Montane grassland on Nyika at two thousand metres, and cedar forest on the Zomba plateau.

malawi/heritage.alt: Evening sky over calm lake water, Malawi
malawi/heritage.altIntended: granite boulders and clear shallow water in Lake Malawi National Park
malawi/heritage.caption: Lake Malawi National Park
malawi/heritage.description: The first freshwater national park in the world, listed for its cichlids.

malawi/hero.alt: Ducks walking by lake shore in malawi village
malawi/hero.altIntended: the clear water and rocky shore of Lake Malawi at Cape Maclear
malawi/hero.caption: The Lake
malawi/hero.description: Five hundred kilometres of it, and more fish species than any other lake in the world.

malawi/hidden-gems.altIntended: the large Anglican cathedral standing over Likoma island, Malawi
malawi/hidden-gems.caption: Likoma Island
malawi/hidden-gems.description: A Malawian island inside Mozambican water, with a cathedral the size of Winchester's.

malawi/historic-sites.alt: Historic stone church with ivy covered archway, Malawi
malawi/historic-sites.altIntended: the stone church and manse of Livingstonia on the escarpment, Malawi
malawi/historic-sites.caption: Livingstonia
malawi/historic-sites.description: A mission on the escarpment built in 1894, with the manse, the church and the view intact.

malawi/local-life.alt: Tranquil day on african lake with fishermen, Malawi
malawi/local-life.altIntended: fishing boats and children on the beach at Cape Maclear, Malawi
malawi/local-life.caption: The Beach at Cape Maclear
malawi/local-life.description: Fishermen, boats, children and visitors on the same strip of sand all day.

malawi/luxury.alt: Luxury outdoor patio at modern safari lodge, Malawi
malawi/luxury.altIntended: a lakeside lodge deck over clear water at dusk, Malawi
malawi/luxury.caption: Small and Well Run
malawi/luxury.description: Lakeshore lodges, Mkulumadzi at Majete, and Kaya Mawa on Likoma island.

malawi/mountains.altIntended: the granite peaks and plateaux of the Mulanje massif, Malawi
malawi/mountains.caption: Mulanje
malawi/mountains.description: 3,002 metres at Sapitwa, a granite massif with huts, paths and a week of walking on it.

malawi/nature.alt: Path between tea plantations against mountains in misty weather, Malawi
malawi/nature.altIntended: Empty narrow pathway between lush green tea shrubs and trees against mounts under cloudy sky on foggy day, Malawi
malawi/nature.caption: The Rift and the Massif
malawi/nature.description: The Rift Valley floor with the lake in it, and Mulanje standing three thousand metres above the tea.

malawi/outdoor.alt: Parents with kid at zebra crossing, Malawi
malawi/outdoor.altIntended: A family walking across a zebra crossing, representing safety and care., Malawi
malawi/outdoor.caption: Mulanje for a Week
malawi/outdoor.description: Hut to hut across the massif, with porters, and paths that have been there a century.

malawi/safari.alt: An elephant on the river, Malawi
malawi/safari.altIntended: elephants on the Shire river bank in Liwonde, Malawi
malawi/safari.caption: Liwonde and Majete
malawi/safari.description: Both restocked from near-empty — Majete had nothing in 2003 and has the big five now.

malawi/traditional-people.alt: A village in the mountains with a lot of trees, Malawi
malawi/traditional-people.altIntended: Gule Wamkulu masked dancers performing in a village, Malawi
malawi/traditional-people.caption: Chewa, Yao, Tumbuka, Lomwe
malawi/traditional-people.description: The Chewa Gule Wamkulu masquerade is on the UNESCO list and is danced still.

malawi/waterfalls.altIntended: the Manchewe falls dropping off the escarpment near Livingstonia, Malawi
malawi/waterfalls.caption: Manchewe
malawi/waterfalls.description: Off the Nyika escarpment near Livingstonia, with a cave behind the water.

malawi/why-visit.alt: A sailboat on the ocean, Malawi
malawi/why-visit.altIntended: a dhow under sail on Lake Malawi at sunset
malawi/why-visit.caption: Why Malawi
malawi/why-visit.description: A lake with more fish species than any other on earth, and parks brought back from nothing.

malawi/wildlife.alt: People collecting fishing nets on beach, Malawi
malawi/wildlife.altIntended: brightly coloured mbuna cichlids over rocks in Lake Malawi
malawi/wildlife.caption: Cichlids, and the Big Five
malawi/wildlife.description: Hundreds of endemic cichlids in the lake, and the big five back in the parks on shore.

mali/adventure.alt: Serene botanical garden pathway in spring, Mali
mali/adventure.altIntended: Tranquil garden path under a canopy of trees, surrounded by lush greenery and spring blooms., Mali
mali/adventure.caption: Walking the Dogon Country
mali/adventure.description: Village to village along the escarpment, sleeping on roofs, four days or fourteen.

mali/architecture.alt: Brown wooden door on brown concrete wall, Mali
mali/architecture.altIntended: the buttressed mud facade and wooden beams of a Sahelian mosque, Mali
mali/architecture.caption: Sudano-Sahelian

south-sudan/eco-tourism.description: Half the water entering the Sudd evaporates in it. The wetland is a climate system.

south-sudan/family-community.alt: Diverse high school girls in classroom setting, South Sudan
south-sudan/family-community.altIntended: a village school class sitting outside under a tree, South Sudan
south-sudan/family-community.caption: Hard Country for It
south-sudan/family-community.description: This is not a family destination yet, and pretending otherwise would not help anyone.

south-sudan/festivals.alt: African drummers performing in traditional attire, South Sudan
south-sudan/festivals.altIntended: traditional wrestlers and a drumming crowd at a village match, South Sudan
south-sudan/festivals.caption: Wrestling
south-sudan/festivals.description: Dinka and Mundari wrestling matches draw whole districts, with drumming and singing round the ring.

south-sudan/food.altIntended: grilled Nile perch and flatbread served on a riverbank, South Sudan
south-sudan/food.caption: Kisra, Asida and Fish
south-sudan/food.description: Sorghum asida, kisra flatbread, and Nile perch grilled on the bank.

south-sudan/forests.alt: Stunning western ghats landscape in karnataka, South Sudan

south-sudan/forests.caption: The Southern Forests
south-sudan/forests.description: Guinea-Congolian rainforest at the Congo border, with forest elephant and chimpanzee in it.

south-sudan/heritage.alt: Local people sitting outdoors in village, South Sudan
south-sudan/heritage.altIntended: elders sitting under a large tree at a village meeting, South Sudan
south-sudan/heritage.caption: Nothing on the List Yet
south-sudan/heritage.description: No World Heritage sites, and a heritage that is living rather than ruined.

south-sudan/hero.alt: Closeup of a herd of cows walking on a dirt road, South Sudan
south-sudan/hero.altIntended: Mundari herders among long-horned cattle in dung smoke at dawn, South Sudan
south-sudan/hero.caption: Cattle Camps at Dawn
south-sudan/hero.description: Mundari herders and their Ankole cattle in smoke from dung fires, on the White Nile.

south-sudan/hidden-gems.alt: Ruins of philae temple, South Sudan
south-sudan/hidden-gems.altIntended: the Nile running through green hills at Nimule, South Sudan
south-sudan/hidden-gems.caption: Nimule
south-sudan/hidden-gems.description: A small park on the Ugandan border with elephant, and the Nile going through it.

south-sudan/historic-sites.alt: Three men sitting on the ground next to a river, South Sudan
south-sudan/historic-sites.altIntended: the ruins of a colonial-era river station on the White Nile, South Sudan
south-sudan/historic-sites.caption: Lado and the Old Posts
south-sudan/historic-sites.description: The Lado Enclave, Gondokoro and the river stations of the nineteenth-century Nile expeditions.

south-sudan/lakes-rivers.alt: Brown crocodile on green grass field, South Sudan
south-sudan/lakes-rivers.altIntended: Close-up of an African crocodile resting near the water in South Africa, showcasing its textured scales and sharp teeth., South Sudan
south-sudan/lakes-rivers.caption: The White Nile
south-sudan/lakes-rivers.description: It runs the length of the country and it is the reason for everything here.

south-sudan/local-life.alt: Pack donkey carrying plastic containers in field, South Sudan
south-sudan/local-life.altIntended: a busy open-air market with cattle and traders at Terekeka, South Sudan
south-sudan/local-life.caption: Market Day at Terekeka
south-sudan/local-life.description: Cattle, sorghum, fish and tea, and the whole district in one place.

south-sudan/luxury.alt: Multicolored camping tents on mountain peak during sundown, South Sudan
south-sudan/luxury.altIntended: Colorful tents located at camp in mountainous valley near green trees against picturesque sunset sky, South Sudan
south-sudan/luxury.caption: Two Camps
south-sudan/luxury.description: There is a mobile camp on the migration and very little else. That is the honest position.

south-sudan/mountains.alt: Top view of mountains, South Sudan

south-sudan/mountains.caption: The Imatong
south-sudan/mountains.description: Mount Kinyeti at 3,187 metres on the Ugandan border, the highest point in the country.

south-sudan/nature.alt: Man diving into a clear lake surrounded by nature, South Sudan

south-sudan/nature.caption: The Sudd
south-sudan/nature.description: One of the largest wetlands on earth, where the Nile spreads out and slows almost to a stop.

south-sudan/outdoor.alt: Child walking through lush green forest trail, South Sudan
south-sudan/outdoor.altIntended: Young child exploring a lush green forest path on a sunny day, surrounded by tall trees., South Sudan
south-sudan/outdoor.caption: Walking the Imatong
south-sudan/outdoor.description: Cool forest, waterfalls and Kinyeti, from Gilo. Guides are essential and available.

south-sudan/photography.alt: Herd of cattle and goats under a clear sky, South Sudan
south-sudan/photography.altIntended: sunlight through dung smoke over cattle horns at a Mundari camp, South Sudan
south-sudan/photography.caption: Smoke and Horns
south-sudan/photography.description: A Mundari camp at first light, when the fires are lit and the light comes through them.

south-sudan/safari.alt: People and car on grassland at dusk, South Sudan
south-sudan/safari.altIntended: open grassland and scattered trees in Boma National Park, South Sudan
south-sudan/safari.caption: Boma and Badingilo
south-sudan/safari.description: Two parks either side of the migration route, with almost no infrastructure and no crowds.

south-sudan/traditional-people.alt: Portrait of nigerian man in traditional attire, South Sudan
south-sudan/traditional-people.altIntended: a Mundari man resting against the flank of a long-horned bull, South Sudan
south-sudan/traditional-people.caption: The Mundari
south-sudan/traditional-people.description: Cattle are wealth, name and argument. A camp of them at dusk is unlike anything else.

south-sudan/waterfalls.alt: Serene sky over lush green marshland, South Sudan
south-sudan/waterfalls.altIntended: white water at the Fula rapids on the White Nile, South Sudan
south-sudan/waterfalls.caption: Fula Falls
south-sudan/waterfalls.description: The Nile dropping through rock at Fula, on its way north out of Uganda.

south-sudan/why-visit.alt: Cyclist passing by aiwerioba oguigo mansion shopping mall in benin city nigeria, South Sudan
south-sudan/why-visit.altIntended: a single vehicle beside an immense herd of kob on open plain, South Sudan
south-sudan/why-visit.caption: Why South Sudan
south-sudan/why-visit.description: A migration to rival the Serengeti's, seen by a few dozen people a year.

south-sudan/wildlife.alt: Herd of wildebeest standing on green grass field, South Sudan
south-sudan/wildlife.altIntended: a vast herd of white-eared kob crossing open grassland, South Sudan
south-sudan/wildlife.caption: The Great Kob Migration
south-sudan/wildlife.description: White-eared kob, tiang and Mongalla gazelle — counted at over a million animals.

sudan/adventure.alt: Close up of red coral reef, Sudan
sudan/adventure.altIntended: a dive boat anchored over a reef in the Sudanese Red Sea
sudan/adventure.caption: Diving and Desert Driving
sudan/adventure.description: Liveaboards out of Port Sudan, and four-wheel-drive routes between the pyramid fields.
sudan/adventure.photographer: 沖縄ダイビングスクール ワールドダイビング

sudan/architecture.alt: Close up of brown nubian goat resting outdoors, Sudan

sudan/architecture.caption: Mud Brick and Painted Doors

sudan/beaches.alt: Diving adventure in the red sea depths, Sudan
sudan/beaches.altIntended: a coral wall and reef fish at Sanganeb atoll in the Red Sea, Sudan
sudan/beaches.caption: Reefs Nobody Dives
sudan/beaches.description: Sanganeb atoll and Sha'ab Rumi, where Cousteau sank Conshelf II and the coral grew over it.

sudan/cities.alt: Bazaar in city in evening, Sudan

sudan/cities.caption: Khartoum and Omdurman
sudan/cities.description: Two cities facing each other across the confluence, one colonial grid and one enormous souk.

sudan/crafts.alt: Close up abstract of palm leaf patterns, Sudan
sudan/crafts.altIntended: Artistic close-up of palm leaf creating diagonal abstract patterns., Sudan
sudan/crafts.caption: Basketry and Silver
sudan/crafts.description: Coiled palm baskets from the north, Beja swords, and silver from the Omdurman souk.

sudan/culture.alt: Sailing on the nile river in lush egypt, Sudan
sudan/culture.altIntended: a decorated Nubian house with a painted doorway on the Nile, Sudan
sudan/culture.caption: Nubian, Arab, Beja
sudan/culture.description: Nubian along the northern Nile, Beja in the Red Sea hills, and nearly six hundred groups altogether.

sudan/eco-tourism.altIntended: a tapped acacia trunk with gum arabic crystals on the bark, Sudan
sudan/eco-tourism.caption: Gum Arabic and the Acacia Belt
sudan/eco-tourism.description: A gum tapped from wild acacia by hand, in most of the soft drinks in the world.

sudan/family-community.altIntended: small farms and palms on Tuti island in the Nile at Khartoum, Sudan
sudan/family-community.caption: The Nile at Tuti
sudan/family-community.description: The island in the confluence, farmed, walkable, and reached by ferry from three sides.

sudan/festivals.alt: Mesmerizing sufi whirling dervishes in motion, Sudan

sudan/festivals.caption: Sufi Friday at Omdurman
sudan/festivals.description: The Hamed al-Nil tomb, every Friday at sunset, drumming and whirling for two hours.

sudan/food.altIntended: a bowl of ful medames with bread and tea on a table, Sudan
sudan/food.caption: Ful and Kisra
sudan/food.description: Ful medames for breakfast everywhere, kisra sorghum flatbread, and coffee spiced with ginger.

sudan/forests.alt: A close up of a tree with small fruits, Sudan
sudan/forests.altIntended: an acacia woodland tapped for gum arabic in central Sudan
sudan/forests.caption: Acacia and Doum Palm
sudan/forests.description: Gum arabic comes from the acacia belt across the middle of the country. Most of the world's does.

sudan/heritage.alt: Ancient egyptian relief of gods in temple, Sudan
sudan/heritage.altIntended: the flat-topped Gebel Barkal with the temple ruins at its base, Sudan
sudan/heritage.caption: Kush

sudan/hero.altIntended: the Nubian pyramids of Meroe standing on desert dunes, Sudan
sudan/hero.caption: The Pyramids of Meroe
sudan/hero.description: Two hundred of them on a ridge of sand, steeper and smaller than Egypt's, and empty.

sudan/hidden-gems.altIntended: the ruined columns and throne hall of Old Dongola above the Nile, Sudan
sudan/hidden-gems.caption: Old Dongola
sudan/hidden-gems.description: A Christian Nubian capital on the Nile, with a throne hall that became a mosque.

sudan/historic-sites.altIntended: the pyramid field at Nuri with the Nile beyond, Sudan
sudan/historic-sites.caption: Meroe, Nuri and El-Kurru
sudan/historic-sites.description: Three royal cemeteries of the Kingdom of Kush, which ruled Egypt for a century.

sudan/lakes-rivers.alt: A buildings and bridge near the nile river, Sudan
sudan/lakes-rivers.altIntended: the confluence of the Blue and White Nile at Khartoum from the air, Sudan
sudan/lakes-rivers.caption: The Blue and the White
sudan/lakes-rivers.description: They meet at Khartoum, one clear and one brown, and you can see the line between them.

sudan/local-life.alt: Candid nigerian market scene with spices, Sudan
sudan/local-life.altIntended: camels and traders at the Omdurman camel market, Sudan
sudan/local-life.caption: The Camel Market
sudan/local-life.description: Omdurman's camel market on a Saturday, with animals in from Kordofan and Darfur.

sudan/luxury.alt: A tent and desert in the distance, Sudan
sudan/luxury.altIntended: a tented camp on sand within sight of the Meroe pyramids, Sudan
sudan/luxury.caption: Very Little
sudan/luxury.description: A handful of Red Sea liveaboards, and camps at Meroe. That is the whole of it.

sudan/mountains.alt: Rocky mountains under white clouds, Sudan
sudan/mountains.altIntended: A breathtaking view of a mountain range under a vivid blue sky with scattered clouds., Sudan
sudan/mountains.caption: The Red Sea Hills and Jebel Marra
sudan/mountains.description: Granite hills behind Port Sudan, and a volcanic crater lake on Jebel Marra in Darfur.

sudan/nature.altIntended: the Nile curving through desert at the great bend in northern Sudan
sudan/nature.caption: The Great Bend
sudan/nature.description: The Nile turns southwest for three hundred kilometres here, against every expectation.

sudan/outdoor.alt: Footprints in golden beach sand at sunset, Sudan
sudan/outdoor.altIntended: footprints in sand leading up to the Meroe pyramids, Sudan
sudan/outdoor.caption: Walking Between Pyramids
sudan/outdoor.description: There is no fence at Meroe. You walk in off the sand and up the ridge.

sudan/photography.alt: Rippling sand dunes at sunset, Sudan
sudan/photography.altIntended: Textured sand dunes with intricate wave patterns captured at sunset, creating shadows and depth., Sudan
sudan/photography.caption: Pyramids and Dunes
sudan/photography.description: Meroe an hour after dawn, when the sand is still ridged and the shadows are long.

sudan/safari.alt: Zebra drinking water from river, Sudan
sudan/safari.altIntended: acacia woodland and a waterhole in Dinder National Park, Sudan
sudan/safari.caption: Dinder
sudan/safari.description: One of Africa's oldest national parks, and one of the least visited on the continent.

sudan/traditional-people.alt: Traditional tuareg attire in agadez, Sudan
sudan/traditional-people.altIntended: a Nubian woman in a doorway of a brightly painted house, Sudan
sudan/traditional-people.caption: The Nubians
sudan/traditional-people.description: The Nubian villages along the northern Nile paint their houses, and have done for a very long time.

sudan/waterfalls.alt: Sailboat in water in mountains landscape, Sudan
sudan/waterfalls.altIntended: white water over black granite at a Nile cataract, Sudan
sudan/waterfalls.caption: The Cataracts
sudan/waterfalls.description: Six of them on the Nile, rapids where the river crosses granite, and boats have to portage.

sudan/why-visit.alt: Girl with afro hair smiling, Sudan
sudan/why-visit.altIntended: a lone figure walking among the pyramids of Meroe, Sudan
sudan/why-visit.caption: Why Sudan
sudan/why-visit.description: More pyramids than Egypt, no queue at any of them, and a welcome people write books about.

sudan/wildlife.alt: Herd of buffalo on a savannah, Sudan
sudan/wildlife.altIntended: a herd of roan antelope in Dinder National Park, Sudan
sudan/wildlife.caption: Dinder and the Red Sea
sudan/wildlife.description: Dinder on the Ethiopian border holds lion, giraffe and roan; the reefs hold everything else.

tanzania/adventure.alt: Snow capped mountain peak under a blue sky, Tanzania

tanzania/adventure.caption: Uhuru Peak by Machame
tanzania/adventure.description: Six days up the Machame route, one very long night to the summit, and a sunrise you have to earn.

tanzania/architecture.alt: Historic architecture in stone town zanzibar, Tanzania

tanzania/architecture.caption: The Doors of Stone Town
tanzania/architecture.description: Brass-studded Indian doors and carved Omani frames, on coral-rag houses in alleys too narrow to drive.

tanzania/beaches.alt: A woman standing on a beach next to a house, Tanzania
tanzania/beaches.altIntended: white sand and traditional dhows on the beach at Nungwi, Zanzibar, Tanzania
tanzania/beaches.caption: Zanzibar, Nungwi to Paje

tanzania/cities.alt: A large boat filled with people on a body of water, Tanzania
tanzania/cities.altIntended: the harbour and skyline of Dar es Salaam from the water, Tanzania
tanzania/cities.caption: Dar es Salaam
tanzania/cities.description: Harbour of peace: the ferry terminal, the fish market at Kivukoni, and the dhows still working the channel.

tanzania/crafts.alt: Artisan carving wood in traditional workshop setting, Tanzania
tanzania/crafts.altIntended: A craftsman skillfully carves wood in a traditional workshop. Rustic surroundings emphasize a cultural atmosphere., Tanzania
tanzania/crafts.caption: Tingatinga and Makonde
tanzania/crafts.description: Enamel-bright Tingatinga painting from Dar es Salaam, and Makonde ebony carving from the southern plateau.

tanzania/culture.alt: Woman in red and white dress wearing black leather boots, Tanzania
tanzania/culture.altIntended: Maasai men in ceremonial dress on the northern Tanzanian plains
tanzania/culture.caption: Maasai, Chagga, Swahili
tanzania/culture.description: Cattle-keepers on the northern plains, coffee farmers on the mountain, and a coast that has always faced east.

tanzania/eco-tourism.altIntended: Maasai herders and cattle on the Ngorongoro conservation area highlands, Tanzania
tanzania/eco-tourism.caption: Ngorongoro, Shared Ground
tanzania/eco-tourism.description: The conservation area is the rare model where Maasai pastoralists and wildlife legally use the same land.

tanzania/family-community.alt: Landscape with the mount kilimanjaro, Tanzania
tanzania/family-community.altIntended: a Chagga family roasting coffee on a farm below Kilimanjaro, Tanzania
tanzania/family-community.caption: Boma and Coffee Farm
tanzania/family-community.description: Maasai boma visits on the crater rim road, and Chagga coffee walks on the lower slopes of Kilimanjaro.

tanzania/festivals.alt: Vibrant street musicians playing percussion instruments, Tanzania
tanzania/festivals.altIntended: musicians performing at the Sauti za Busara festival in Stone Town, Tanzania
tanzania/festivals.caption: Sauti za Busara
tanzania/festivals.description: Four days of live music from across the continent inside the old Arab fort in Stone Town, every February.

tanzania/food.alt: Tower of the saint joseph church in stone town zanzibar, Tanzania
tanzania/food.altIntended: grilled seafood stalls at Forodhani Gardens in Stone Town, Tanzania
tanzania/food.caption: Spice, Ugali, Urojo
tanzania/food.description: Cloves and cardamom from the Zanzibar plantations, grilled seafood at Forodhani, and ugali everywhere else.

tanzania/forests.alt: A couple of monkeys sitting on top of a tree branch, Tanzania
tanzania/forests.altIntended: a Zanzibar red colobus monkey in Jozani Forest, Tanzania
tanzania/forests.caption: Udzungwa and Jozani
tanzania/forests.description: The Udzungwa scarp holds species found nowhere else; Jozani holds the red colobus, also found nowhere else.

tanzania/heritage.alt: Two zebras are standing on a grassy hill, Tanzania
tanzania/heritage.altIntended: the layered walls of Olduvai Gorge in the Ngorongoro conservation area, Tanzania
tanzania/heritage.caption: Olduvai and the Coast
tanzania/heritage.description: Olduvai Gorge holds the earliest human record; the coast holds a thousand years of Indian Ocean trade.

tanzania/hero.alt: Green tree on green grass field during daytime, Tanzania
tanzania/hero.altIntended: the endless short-grass plains of the Serengeti at sunrise, Tanzania
tanzania/hero.caption: Into the Wild
tanzania/hero.description: The Serengeti runs unbroken to the horizon, and the migration has been circling it far longer than anyone has watched.

tanzania/hidden-gems.altIntended: elephants beneath baobabs in Ruaha National Park, Tanzania
tanzania/hidden-gems.caption: Ruaha and Katavi
tanzania/hidden-gems.description: The south and west: huge elephant populations, hippo crowded into shrinking pools, and no other vehicles.

tanzania/historic-sites.alt: Sailboat swimming by the coast with tropical resort, Tanzania
tanzania/historic-sites.altIntended: Charming sailboat on the vibrant waters of Zanzibar against a historic cityscape., Tanzania
tanzania/historic-sites.caption: Stone Town and Kilwa
tanzania/historic-sites.description: Stone Town is UNESCO-listed; Kilwa Kisiwani was the richest port on the Swahili coast six centuries ago.

tanzania/lakes-rivers.alt: Three elephants are standing in a grassy field bGJK uwOpbQ, Tanzania
tanzania/lakes-rivers.altIntended: the Rufiji river braiding through Nyerere National Park, Tanzania
tanzania/lakes-rivers.caption: Manyara and the Rufiji
tanzania/lakes-rivers.description: Flamingo and tree-climbing lions at Manyara; the Rufiji braiding through Nyerere, the largest park in Africa.

tanzania/local-life.alt: Woman in blue and yellow floral shirt standing beside the green banana fruits, Tanzania
tanzania/local-life.altIntended: the early morning fish market at Kivukoni in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
tanzania/local-life.caption: Dala Dalas and Dhows
tanzania/local-life.description: Minibuses inland, dhows on the water, and a fish auction at Kivukoni that starts before it is light.

tanzania/luxury.alt: Zebras and elephants on grass field, Tanzania
tanzania/luxury.altIntended: a luxury tented camp on the Serengeti plains at dusk, Tanzania
tanzania/luxury.caption: Camps and Spice Islands
tanzania/luxury.description: Mobile camps that follow the migration, and beach houses on the Zanzibar east coast with nothing either side.

tanzania/mountains.alt: A snow covered mountain from a building, Tanzania
tanzania/mountains.altIntended: the snow-capped summit of Kilimanjaro above the cloud line, Tanzania
tanzania/mountains.caption: Kilimanjaro, 5,895 m
tanzania/mountains.description: The highest free-standing mountain on earth: rainforest, moorland, alpine desert and glacier in five days of walking.

tanzania/nature.alt: Brown rabbit on green grass field during daytime, Tanzania
tanzania/nature.altIntended: the floor of the Ngorongoro Crater seen from the rim, Tanzania
tanzania/nature.caption: The Ngorongoro Crater
tanzania/nature.description: A collapsed caldera twenty kilometres across with its own permanent population of thirty thousand animals.

tanzania/outdoor.altIntended: snorkelling over coral reef at Mnemba atoll, Zanzibar, Tanzania
tanzania/outdoor.caption: Snorkelling Mnemba
tanzania/outdoor.description: The atoll off the northeast tip of Zanzibar, plus kite surfing at Paje and diving at Pemba.

tanzania/photography.alt: Scenic dirt road in serengeti tanzania
tanzania/photography.altIntended: an acacia silhouetted against the Serengeti sunset, Tanzania
tanzania/photography.caption: Acacia, Kopje, Sunset
tanzania/photography.description: The Serengeti kopjes at the end of the day, and the migration column stretching past the edge of the frame.

tanzania/safari.alt: 2 zebra on brown grass field during daytime, Tanzania
tanzania/safari.altIntended: wildebeest herds streaming across the Serengeti plains, Tanzania
tanzania/safari.caption: Following the Migration
tanzania/safari.description: Calving on the southern plains in February, the Grumeti in June, the Mara river in August — the circuit never stops.

tanzania/traditional-people.alt: Woman in yellow and black polka dot shirt, Tanzania
tanzania/traditional-people.altIntended: Maasai woman adorned in traditional attire and jewelry in Tanzania.
tanzania/traditional-people.caption: The Hadzabe of Lake Eyasi
tanzania/traditional-people.description: One of the last hunter-gatherer peoples in Africa, speaking a click language unrelated to anything nearby.

tanzania/waterfalls.alt: Men enjoying a waterfall in lush jungle, Tanzania
tanzania/waterfalls.altIntended: the Materuni waterfall in the forest below Kilimanjaro, Tanzania
tanzania/waterfalls.caption: Materuni, Under Kilimanjaro
tanzania/waterfalls.description: Eighty metres of cold water through Chagga coffee farms on the lower slopes, an easy walk from Moshi.

tanzania/why-visit.alt: Misty landscape of kilimanjaro national park, Tanzania
tanzania/why-visit.altIntended: Kilimanjaro rising above the acacia plains at sunrise, Tanzania
tanzania/why-visit.caption: Mountain, Plain and Reef
tanzania/why-visit.description: Summit Africa's highest mountain, cross the Serengeti and sleep on the Indian Ocean, in the same fortnight.

tanzania/wildlife.alt: Zebras standing on a green grass field, Tanzania
tanzania/wildlife.altIntended: a lion pride resting on a kopje in the Serengeti, Tanzania
tanzania/wildlife.caption: The Big Five, and Then Some
tanzania/wildlife.description: Lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo and rhino, plus the largest elephant herds left in East Africa.

togo/adventure.alt: Woman walking on a passageway, Togo
togo/adventure.altIntended: a walking path through cocoa and coffee smallholdings near Kpalime, Togo
togo/adventure.caption: Walking Around Kpalime
togo/adventure.description: Waterfalls, coffee farms, Mont Agou and the butterfly forest, all within an hour.
togo/adventure.photographer: ธันยกร ไกรสร

togo/architecture.alt: Traditional mud hut with thatched roof, Togo
togo/architecture.altIntended: the sculpted mud tower and granary of a takienta house, Togo
togo/architecture.caption: Towers of Mud
togo/architecture.description: Takienta houses with granaries on top, and German colonial stone in Lome and Aneho.

togo/beaches.alt: Vibrant beach scene with fishermen in togo
togo/beaches.altIntended: coconut palms and Atlantic surf on the beach near Aneho, Togo
togo/beaches.caption: Fifty Kilometres of Coast
togo/beaches.description: Palm-backed Atlantic sand from Lome east to Aneho, with a heavy swell.

togo/cities.alt: Tropical beach with palm trees and clear blue sea, Togo
togo/cities.altIntended: Serene tropical beach with palm trees, turquoise waters, and clear blue sky., Togo
togo/cities.caption: Lome
togo/cities.description: The only capital on a border, with the biggest market in the region behind the beach.

togo/crafts.alt: Washed rags drying on a clothesline, Togo
